name: WERK IDEENWERK AI synthesis contract
purpose: Generate and persist multiple source-bound solution variants from the citizen problem, a current WERK Impact Bridge mapping, and citizen-visible expert/affected-party evidence, without political ranking or manufactured fiscal effects.

prerequisites.impact_bridge: COUNTERCHECKED_STAGING and current candidate_mapping required for the specific submission
prerequisites.expert_process: COUNTERCHECKED_STAGING and at least one citizen-visible source-bound expert/affected-party input required for the specific submission
prerequisites.source_snapshot: submission + structured proposal timestamps, current Impact Bridge version/mappings, and citizen-visible expert input IDs
prerequisites.stale_behavior: fail closed to revalidation_required; stale variants are not returned as current

provider_contract.default: disabled; never manufacture fallback policy variants

storage_contract.idempotency: same idempotency key plus same source-bound payload replays; changed payload fails closed

variant_schema.source_ref_rule: Every source_ref must resolve against the current source snapshot. Unknown or stale references fail closed.
variant_schema.numeric_effect_rule: Generated variant text does not reproduce or invent fiscal percentages/currency effects. Quantitative claims stay in linked WERK calculation artifacts.

citizen_transparency.boundary: Variants are research and deliberation material, not a WERK recommendation or decision.

negative_guards: no synthesis when current impact mapping is missing or stale
no synthesis when citizen-visible expert input is absent
new percentage/currency-scale effect text fails closed
source snapshot change makes stored synthesis revalidation_required
provider disabled produces no fallback variants

runtime.note: Repository contract is safe to deploy without enabling an external model endpoint.
